question: Ministry of New & Renewable Energy participated in World Hydrogen Summit 2025, highlighting India’s vision and capabilities in Renewable Energy and Green Hydrogen. Where it was held?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Rotterdam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Ministry of New & Renewable Energy participates in World Hydrogen Summit 2025, highlights India’s vision and capabilities in Renewable Energy and Green Hydrogen.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
Ministry of New & Renewable Energy took part in **World Hydrogen Summit 2025** in **Rotterdam**.

 
 
• 
 
India highlighted its **renewable energy** and **Green Hydrogen** vision.

 
 
• 
 
**National Green Hydrogen Mission** was launched in **2023** with an initial outlay of **USD 2.4 billion**.

 
 
• 
 
The mission aims to:

 
 
• 
 
Create sectoral demand for Green Hydrogen.

 
 
• 
 
Give production incentives to boost domestic capacity.

 
 
• 
 
Achieve **5 million metric tonnes (MMT)** of green hydrogen production by **2030**.

 
 
• 
 
Avoid **50 MMT of CO₂ emissions annually**.

 
 
• 
 
Attract **USD 100 billion in investments**.

 
 
• 
 
Create over **600,000 jobs**.

 
 
 
 
• 
 
India has launched a **Green Hydrogen Certification Scheme**.

 
 
• 
 
**Green Hydrogen and Green Ammonia plants** are **exempt from environmental clearance**.

 
 
• 
 
Three ports — **Kandla**, **Paradip**, and **Tuticorin** — will be developed as **Green Hydrogen hubs** by the **Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways**.
